title: NBI says ashes from Cavite crematorium not pet remains—PAWS

blocks.text: The ashes a pet crematorium in Bacoor, Cavite, gave to fur parents are not pet remains but contain silicon, iron, potassium and aluminum, the National Bureau of Investigation's (NBI) forensic examination showed, according to Philippine Animal Welfare Society Executive Director Anna Cabrera.
